selectionRule: Enumerate node support-moment requests whose source rotational DOF is free, then require the complete executed native zero-rotation and retained-DOF proof. Never select by magnitude or diagnostic failure.
noCouplingMeaning: No support translation-to-rotation or rotation-to-rotation coupling, eccentric constraint, diaphragm or MPC action in this bounded executed-model domain. Ordinary structural member stiffness coupling is allowed and is not asserted to vanish.
proofBoundary: No standalone undocumented SAT field is used as universal proof: API definition/binding, compiled-and-postsolve exact blocks, node indexing, retained full DOFs, complete model/load audit and previous independent six-DOF/force review are jointly required.
failClosed: Unknown case/state/request/native version or changed SHA.
